project_info.theme: Student success story for emlyon business school and École Centrale de Lyon
project_info.color_palette: Navy Blue, Red, White, Cream, Warm Skin Tones

main_subject.detail: A scrapbook-style academic success poster for Lê Minh Đức featuring a large red-white nameplate, a cream open-book panel with academic bullet points, a polaroid portrait holding certificates and medals, official admission proof documents, and a smaller formal portrait at the lower left.
main_subject.style: Proof-heavy student case study poster with layered paper textures, French motifs, institutional logos, and admissions-document evidence.

composition_elements.text:
VFE VIETNAM FRANCE EXCHANGE
Lê Minh Đức
Trúng tuyển chương trình Cử nhân Khoa học Dữ liệu do emlyon business school phối hợp cùng École Centrale de Lyon
GPA 3 năm cấp 3 >9.0
Founder Tổ chức Giáo dục & Văn Hóa ICEPY
Tổng Đạo Diễn Chương Trình Nghệ Thuật Chính Luận "Khát Vọng Vươn Mình 2025"
Du học hè 2024 tại Oxford (Anh)
Chứng chỉ IELTS 7.0 & TCF B1
2K8 THPT Hàm Rồng (Thanh Hoá)
NHẬN TƯ VẤN NGAY
items: Top Left: VFE logo and giant red-white nameplate 'Lê Minh Đức'.
Top Right: Polaroid portrait of the student with certificates and medals, plus a French flag and red curtain background.
Bottom Left: Formal portrait photo, Eiffel stamp doodle, Arc de Triomphe illustration, and open admission document area with emlyon and Centrale Lyon logos.
Bottom Right: Red rounded CTA 'NHẬN TƯ VẤN NGAY' and the lower portion of the large polaroid.
Center/Background: Cream open-book note panel listing six bullet achievements and proof documents layered underneath.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Readable paper layers, clean proof-document contrast, and warm student-portrait realism.

technical_specs.render_style: Scrapbook-style academic success case study poster

Centerpiece is a cream open-book panel listing academic and extracurricular achievements, surrounded by a large polaroid portrait with certificates and medals, official admission proof papers, and French landmark motifs. Background is a navy paper-collage field with VFE branding. Surrounding elements: nameplate 'Lê Minh Đức', references to emlyon business school and École Centrale de Lyon, school identity '2K8 THPT Hàm Rồng (Thanh Hoá)', and red CTA 'NHẬN TƯ VẤN NGAY'. Technical style: scrapbook-style academic success case study poster, soft editorial lighting, proof-heavy admissions evidence, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
